sampling_policy: frozen deterministic base; phase-local perturbed-v1 reset seeds; no action noise
architecture: 48-128-128-1 ELU; existing online PPO critic; no input/target normalization
heldout_use: evaluate only fixed final epoch; no tuning/checkpoint selection from heldout
targets: full finite-horizon reward-only MC; physical/collector truncations rejected, all failures retained
metrics: pooled and per-episode RMSE/NRMSE/bias/EV/R2; pre-action progress thirds and nonfoot-contact strata
